items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Joe Grady was acting for me

ctx.x: However, I beat my side of the case because all of us was in the same thing,

that's what it was. They got me for being with them and my reason for being with them and I got the AGVA to stand for me in the trial they had and everything. I won my case. But later on I found out this guy had stashed stuff in the car. Buck had stashed stuff in my car and I didn't know it and it's a good thing the police didn't go through the car like a fine tooth comb because they would have had to find it because in some of his clothes they found parts of marijuana, you know. But they didn't look in the glove…

found the marijuana in the glove compartment. I said, ain't this something. That scared me to death, 'cause I didn't want to say nothin'. Man, I was scared to death and I was going on down the road. But anyway, I beat that one. Thank God.
